question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate homophone to substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.**

These ornaments are **__coated with gold__**.
solution: The correct answer is** "gild."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Gild"** means to cover something with a thin layer of gold. (किसी चीज़ को सोने की पतली परत से ढकना). • **Example**: *Her bracelet was **gild**__.* • ***​*"Coated with gold" **means **"gild."** • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Gilled"** is the past participle form of **"gill,"** which means to cut the gills out of a fish. (मछली के गलफड़ों को काटना) • **"Gel"** can refer to a hair styling product, a substance used in laboratory experiments, or a dessert. (एक गाढ़ा पदार्थ (द्रव और ठोस के बीच का), जैल, जेली) • "Guild" refers to a group of people with a common interest or profession. (समान व्‍यवसाय, अभिरुचि या लक्ष्‍य वाले व्‍यक्तियों का संगठन; गिल्‍ड) 3b:T723, The correct answer is** "not only have the ability to read voraciously but also have."**
